headline: Spot Bitcoin ETFs Attract $1.08 Billion in Three Days as Rally Pace Moderates
summary: US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds recorded $1.08 billion of net inflows over three trading days, though current daily flows remain below levels seen during previous steep rallies.
why: Spot Bitcoin ETFs are the primary vehicle for institutional crypto exposure, and their net flows serve as a key sentiment indicator for digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Net inflows into spot ETFs generate underlying spot market buying demand across custody providers.
